notes: Grab (moto/car) is cheap. Scooter 150,000/day (international licence needed). Hoi An is 45 minutes away, and the airport is within the city.
June-August is dry at 33°C, the sea is calm and Cù Lao Chàm is open. Rain begins in September, and typhoons come in October-November.
Vietnam e-visa is valid for 90 days (e-visa for Turkish citizens). Carry cash in VND (1 USD ≈ 25,000, ASSUMPTION), cards work at hotels.
Bánh mì 25-30,000, mì quảng 40,000, restaurant 150-250,000, Ba Na 950,000, Hoi An ticket 120,000. No tipping, and bargain at markets.
Be at Ba Na at the 08:00 opening (the Golden Bridge is empty) and Mỹ Sơn at 07:00. Visit Marble Mountains in the morning. Dragon Bridge show is on Saturdays and Sundays at 21:00.
Try cao lầu (Hoi An), mì quảng, bánh xèo, salt coffee and egg coffee. Street food is safe at busy stalls.

stops.name: My Khe Beach
stops.tips: One of Forbes' most beautiful beaches. Locals swim in the morning, so come for sunrise. Sun lounger 50,000.

stops.name: Bánh Mì Bà Lan
stops.tips: Da Nang's legendary bánh mì (Vietnamese baguette sandwich). Expect a queue in the morning.

stops.name: Linh Ung Pagoda Lady Buddha
stops.tips: A 67 m Lady Buddha on the Son Tra peninsula with views over the bay. 20 minutes by scooter or Grab.

stops.name: Mì Quảng 1A
stops.tips: A classic for Quang noodles (mì quảng), on Hai Phong street.

stops.name: Dragon Bridge Fire Show
stops.tips: On Saturdays and Sundays at 21:00 the dragon breathes fire and water. One of the bridges over the Han River.

backups.name: Han Market
backups.tips: The central market, with a food floor and dried fruit.

backups.name: Museum of Cham Sculpture
backups.tips: The world's largest collection of Cham sculpture. A rainy-day alternative to the Buddha.

stops.name: Ba Na Hills Cable Car
stops.tips: One of the world's longest cable cars (5.8 km), climbing to 1,487 m. Ticket 950,000 VND (all day), opens 08:00.

stops.name: Golden Bridge Cầu Vàng
stops.tips: A golden bridge held up by giant stone hands. Crowded after 09:30 and may be misty.

stops.name: Le Jardin d'Amour & Linh Ung Ba Na
stops.tips: French gardens and a pagoda on the hilltop.

stops.name: French Village Ba Na
stops.tips: An artificial French village and Fantasy Park (including an indoor amusement park), with shows.

stops.name: Ba Na Buffet Lunch
stops.tips: Buffet restaurants at the top. Head back at 15:00.

backups.name: Fantasy Park Ba Na
backups.tips: An indoor amusement park, included in the ticket. An alternative to the village if you have children.

backups.name: Bếp Cuốn Da Nang
backups.tips: An evening in the city: Vietnamese rolls (cuốn) with rice paper platters.

stops.name: Marble Mountains Ngũ Hành Sơn
stops.tips: Five marble hills. See the beam of light in Huyen Khong cave. Lift 15,000, cooler in the morning.

stops.name: Hội An Ancient Town
stops.tips: A UNESCO-listed 16th-century port town with yellow houses and the Japanese Bridge. Ticket covers 5 sites (120,000).

stops.name: Bánh Mì Phượng
stops.tips: Bourdain's bánh mì, in Hoi An.

stops.name: Hội An Bebe Tailor
stops.tips: Made-to-measure suits and dresses in 24 hours. Hoi An has 400+ tailors.

stops.name: Hội An Lantern Night & Thu Bồn Boat
stops.tips: Lantern boat on the river (150,000), a festival at full moon and the Nguyen Hoang night market. Try cao lầu for dinner.

backups.name: Morning Glory Hoi An
backups.tips: Ms Vy's restaurant, known for cao lầu and white rose dumplings.

backups.name: Precious Heritage Museum Réhahn
backups.tips: The photographer's portraits of 54 ethnic groups. Free, an alternative to the tailor.

days.theme: Hải Vân Pass and Lăng Cô

stops.name: Hải Vân Pass
stops.tips: Top Gear's "best coast road in the world". Go by scooter, easy rider tour or car. The pass is 500 m high, with French and US bunkers.

stops.name: Lăng Cô Lagoon
stops.tips: A turquoise lagoon and fishing village with oyster farms.

stops.name: Lăng Cô Seafood Restaurant
stops.tips: A wooden restaurant over the lagoon serving oysters and prawns.

stops.name: Elephant Springs Suối Voi
stops.tips: Forest pools among elephant-shaped rocks, good for swimming. North of Lăng Cô.

stops.name: Nam Ô Reef Sunset
stops.tips: A rocky headland on the way back to Da Nang, with seaweed-covered rocks (green in March-April).

backups.name: Bạch Mã National Park
backups.tips: Cloud forest and the ruins of French villas. Go by jeep. An alternative to the springs.

backups.name: Bé Mặn Nam Ô
backups.tips: Grilled fish by the sea in Nam Ô.

stops.name: Mỹ Sơn Sanctuary
stops.tips: Hindu temples of the Champa kingdom from the 4th to 13th centuries (a cousin of Angkor). Quiet at the 07:00 opening, Apsara dance at 09:30, tour 1.5 hours.

stops.name: Mỹ Sơn Village Restaurant
stops.tips: Village breakfast and lunch, with bánh xèo (crispy pancake).

stops.name: Thanh Hà Pottery Village
stops.tips: A 500-year-old pottery village next to Hoi An. Try the wheel, and see Terracotta Park.

stops.name: An Bàng Beach
stops.tips: Hoi An's beach, with beach bars, sun loungers and swimming.

stops.name: Sound of Silence An Bang
stops.tips: A beach cafe for sunset coffee.

backups.name: Trà Quế Vegetable Village
backups.tips: An organic garden village with cycling and cooking classes. An alternative to the pottery village.

stops.name: Cù Lao Chàm Island Speedboat
stops.tips: 20 minutes from Cửa Đại (March-September). A UNESCO biosphere island. Tour 450,000, snorkelling and lunch included.

stops.name: Cù Lao Chàm Snorkelling
stops.tips: Coral and fish at Bãi Chồng beach.

stops.name: Island Fishing Village Lunch
stops.tips: Seafood included in the tour, in Bãi Làng village. Boat back at 14:00.

stops.name: Da Nang Evening Bà Dưỡng Bánh Xèo
stops.tips: Da Nang's crispy pancake bánh xèo and nem lụi (lemongrass skewers), in a Hoàng Diệu side street.

backups.name: Hue Imperial City
backups.tips: The Purple Forbidden City. Choose it in winter or if the sea is closed.

backups.name: Quán Trần Da Nang
backups.tips: Bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo (pork rice-paper rolls), a local favourite.

stops.name: Cà Phê Muối Salt Coffee
stops.tips: Hue-style coffee with salty foam. Best in the morning.

stops.name: Con Market Chợ Cồn
stops.tips: A local market for dried beef (bò khô) and coffee souvenirs.

stops.name: Han River Promenade
stops.tips: A riverside walk past the Love Lock Bridge and the Golden Dragon.

stops.name: Madame Lân
stops.tips: A riverside restaurant with a wide Vietnamese menu. Have bún chả cá for your farewell meal.

stops.name: Da Nang International Airport
stops.tips: 10 minutes from the city by Grab. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Bún Chả Cá 109
backups.tips: Fish cake noodle soup, on Nguyễn Chí Thanh.

backups.name: Da Nang Museum
backups.tips: The city's history. An alternative to the market.
